text:
elaine: Quick sync: propose 'Onramp Starter' + optional 'Fastlane' add-on for partner flows. Starter = 8M tokens/mo. Fastlane = pay-per-priority-minute. Need launch gates.

elaine: Key ask: Fastlane must be opt-in, non-SLA, and metered as a separate metric.

omar: Ops: routing tag exists; billing metric needs implementation. ETA 3 dev-days to emit 'priority_minutes' and wire to billing.

rachel: UX: show a simple checkbox in checkout: 'Enable Fastlane (pay as you go)'. Link to short modal. Copy incoming.

legal: I'll draft consent language: explicit opt-in + no SLA wording.

devops-bot: Note: billing preview available 24h after metric ingestion. Ensure ingestion latency <90s.

elaine: Launch criteria: metric emitted, checkout copy live, legal text in place, billing preview validated for 2 pilots. If blockers, ship Starter without Fastlane.

omar: I'll start work and post PR by Wed.

rachel: Copy sent for review.

elaine: Thanks team — aim to finalise gating checklist by Fri. :thumbsup:
